```yaml
slug: dormant-guest-accounts
name: Dormant Guest Accounts
description: Loads guest users from Microsoft Graph and summarizes dormant ones using an LLM.
mode: read
integrations:
  - name: microsoft_graph
    type: api
    scopes:
      - User.Read.All
steps:
  - name: Load Guest Users
    type: api
    integration: microsoft_graph
    method: GET
    endpoint: /users?$filter=userType eq 'Guest'
    output: guest_users
  - name: Identify Dormant Users
    type: script
    language: javascript
    script: |
      const dormant = guest_users.filter(user => {
        const lastSignIn = new Date(user.signInActivity?.lastSignInDateTime);
        const now = new Date();
        const diffDays = (now - lastSignIn) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        return diffDays > 90;
      });
      return dormant;
    input: guest_users
    output: dormant_users
  - name: Summarize Dormant Users
    type: llm
    model: gpt-4
    prompt: |
      Summarize the following dormant guest accounts:
      {{dormant_users}}
    output: summary
```
